problems.title: Longest Palindromic Substring

description.en: Given a string s, return the longest palindromic substring.
description.hi: Ek string s di gayi hai. Sabse lamba palindromic substring return karo.

explanation.en: 'bab' is the longest palindromic substring ('aba' is also valid).
explanation.hi: 'bab' sabse lamba palindromic substring hai ('aba' bhi valid hai).

constraints: s consists of digits and English letters

hints.en: Expand around each center (both odd and even length palindromes).
hints.hi: Har center ke around expand karo (odd aur even length dono ke liye).

starterCode.python: def longest_palindrome(s: str) -> str:\n    # Write your code here\n    pass
starterCode.javascript: function longestPalindrome(s) {\n    // Write your code here\n}

approach.en: Expand around each index as center. For odd-length palindromes use one center; for even-length use two adjacent centers. Track the longest found.
approach.hi: Har index ko center maanke expand karo. Odd-length ke liye ek center, even-length ke liye do adjacent centers use karo. Sabse lamba track karo.

code.python:
def longest_palindrome(s: str) -> str:
    n = len(s)
    start, max_len = 0, 1
    def expand(l, r):
        nonlocal start, max_len
        while l >= 0 and r < n and s[l] == s[r]: l -= 1; r += 1
        if r - l - 1 > max_len: max_len = r - l - 1; start = l + 1
    for i in range(n):
        expand(i, i)
        expand(i, i + 1)
    return s[start:start + max_len]

code.python:
def compress(s: str) -> str:
    result = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(s):
        c = s[i]; cnt = 0
        while i < len(s) and s[i] == c: i += 1; cnt += 1
        result.append(c + str(cnt))
    compressed = ''.join(result)
    return compressed if len(compressed) < len(s) else s

problems.title: Minimum Window Substring

description.en: Given strings s and t, return the minimum window substring of s that contains all characters in t (including duplicates). If no such window exists, return empty string.
description.hi: Strings s aur t di gayi hain. s ka minimum window substring return karo jo t ke saare characters contain kare (duplicates including). Agar aisa koi window nahi hai toh empty string return karo.

explanation.en: The minimum window containing A, B, C is 'BANC'.
explanation.hi: A, B, C contain karne wala minimum window 'BANC' hai.

constraints: s and t consist of uppercase and lowercase English letters

hints.en: Use sliding window with two frequency maps.
hints.hi: Do frequency maps ke saath sliding window use karo.

hints.en: Expand window by moving right pointer, then shrink from left when all characters are covered.
hints.hi: Right pointer move karke window expand karo, phir jab saare characters cover ho jaayein toh left se shrink karo.

approach.en: Use a sliding window with two hash maps — one for required characters from t, one for current window. Use a 'formed' counter to track when all required chars are satisfied. Shrink from left when window is valid.
approach.hi: Do hash maps ke saath sliding window use karo — ek t ke required characters ke liye, ek current window ke liye. 'formed' counter use karo track karne ke liye ki sab required chars satisfy hue ya nahi. Window valid hone par left se shrink karo.

code.python:
from collections import Counter
def min_window(s: str, t: str) -> str:
    if not t or not s: return ''
    need = Counter(t)
    have = {}
    formed = 0
    required = len(need)
    l = 0; min_len = float('inf'); start = 0
    for r, c in enumerate(s):
        have[c] = have.get(c, 0) + 1
        if c in need and have[c] == need[c]: formed += 1
        while formed == required:
            if r - l + 1 < min_len: min_len = r - l + 1; start = l
            have[s[l]] -= 1
            if s[l] in need and have[s[l]] < need[s[l]]: formed -= 1
            l += 1
    return '' if min_len == float('inf') else s[start:start + min_len]
